components.name: Default Button
components.description: Compact native action button for refresh, queue, and navigation work.
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue commit action used for recording a local release.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #0c0f14; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bg); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Wrapping pane selector with an explicit pressed state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-nav-button { background: var(--panel2); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; font: 13px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent); color: #0c0f14; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-nav-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Select
components.description: Native project and filter selection control.
components.css: .ds-field { color: var(--dim); font: 12px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select { display: block; margin-top: 4px; background: var(--panel2); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; min-width: 120px; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Bordered mono label for workflow and review state.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font: 11px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--dim); } .ds-pill-complete { color: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); }

components.name: Console Card
components.description: Tonal container for run status, manuscript output, and review queues.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--panel); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 700 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { max-width: 72ch; font: 14px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Manuscript Reader
components.description: Scrollable bordered prose surface for exact episode and release text.

narrative.overview:
This is a compact, dark operator surface for authors managing long-running webseries. It keeps the existing charcoal layers, blue action language, native controls, and serif manuscript reading surface intact. The visual system is functional and restrained: state, source, decision, and release language carry the interface.

The console uses system sans for workspace chrome and Georgia for prose. It favors borders, tonal layering, and whitespace over decoration. Errors, loading, empty, stale, disabled, and immutable states remain visible in place so author control is clear.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal background with two raised surface levels.
One blue accent for selection, action, focus, and caret states.
Semantic green, gold, and red status colors.
Compact controls with readable manuscript prose.
No external assets, dependencies, shadows, or gradients.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep blue for selection, action, focus, and direct interaction. Use green, gold, and red for state meaning rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Georgia only where the user reads story prose; keep navigation, controls, decisions, and metadata in the system sans voice.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal layers and 1px borders to separate work areas. Do not introduce shadows or decorative effects into this incumbent surface.

dos: Do keep the charcoal background/panel/raised hierarchy and divider slate as the base surface language.
Do reserve action blue for selected navigation, primary actions, hover borders, focus, caret, and selection.
Do use system sans for operating UI and Georgia for manuscript prose.
Do preserve native select, number input, textarea, details, and summary behavior, then style them with the existing tokens.
Do keep errors, loading, empty, stale, blocked, disabled, and immutable-release states inline and readable.
Do keep mobile episode rows stacked at 760px and preserve readable prose at 72ch on wider screens.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual identity, display face, illustration, external asset, dependency, request, gradient, or shadow into this console surface.
Don't use blue as a general decoration or semantic substitute for green, gold, or red state colors.
Don't turn status pills, bordered cards, or native controls into soft-shadowed or oversized marketing surfaces.
Don't hide source changes, stale review context, missing prose, failed requests, or release immutability behind a blank pane.
